rule: per task, class and cap: argmax validation accuracy (seed 0, final epoch) over feasible configurations; ties broken by lower measured peak, then fewer parameters
empty_class: if a class has no feasible configuration at a cap, the cell is reported as infeasible for that class and has no Delta
feasibility_rule: configuration feasible at cap B iff min over knobs of measured peak <= B x 1024 bytes
final_tie_break: lexicographically smallest config_id (PIN; the YAML selection.rule is silent after fewer parameters)
